crew.overview: A young man struggles to access sublimated childhood memories. He finds a technique that allows him to travel back into the past, to occupy his childhood body and change history. However, he soon finds that every change he makes has unexpected consequences.
crew.title: The Butterfly Effect

crew.overview: Four interwoven stories that occur on Halloween: an everyday high school principal has a secret life as a serial killer; a college virgin might have just met the one guy for her; a group of teenagers pull a mean prank, and a bitter old recluse receives an uninvited guest.
crew.title: Trick 'r Treat

details.biography: At 4'8", Suzi Stingl specializes as a stunt double for children - both boys and girls, and and elderly. Suzi's considerable stunt experience and experience includes fighting, high falls, a variety of stunt gags, and underwater performances. Actra member and working with top stunt coordinators across Canada since 1996, Suzi's filmography includes stunts and acting performances in variety of film, movie, and TV genres - horror, drama, action, and comedy.
details.name: Suzi Stingl
